bracket: [Board misprint: as printed, none of the four options is the negation of the given statement. \(\sim (p \land (q \rightarrow r)) \equiv \sim p \vee (q \land \sim r)\), and the combination \((q \land \sim r)\) does not appear in any option. Option (c) is that expression with a single connective wrong — it prints \(\sim p \vee (q \rightarrow \sim r)\) — and the March 2016 paper sets this identical question with the correct form as its option (D), so (c) is what the board intended.
